description:
Team Myles O’Donoghue are delighted to present Apt 4, Shackelton House, Archerswood, Clonee, Dublin 15 to the market.

This superb two-bedroom, two-bathroom apartment offers bright and spacious accommodation throughout, extending to approximately 73
sq. m. The property is ideally positioned within the quiet and highly sought-after Shackelton House development and benefits from a private sunny
balcony overlooking landscaped communal grounds.

The accommodation briefly comprises a welcoming entrance hallway leading to a generous open plan kitchen / living / dining area. The
fully fitted kitchen integrates seamlessly with the main living space, creating an ideal area for both everyday living and entertaining. The living
accommodation also provides direct access to the private balcony.
There are two well-proportioned double bedrooms, with the main bedroom benefiting from a private ensuite bathroom. A separate family
bathroom completes the accommodation. The property further benefits from gas fired central heating, and double glazed windows.

Shackelton House is a well-established residential development ideally positioned close to a wealth of local amenities including
shops, cafés, leisure facilities and recreational amenities. Blanchardstown Shopping Centre is within easy reach, while commuters are exceptionally well
catered for with easy access to the N3, M3 and M50 motorway networks, providing excellent links throughout Dublin and beyond. With its spacious accommodation, private balcony and excellent location, this property is sure to appeal to
first-time buyers, downsizers and investors alike.

Features
•	BER C2 - BER Number 117075325
•	Large Terrace 
•	Maintained Communal Gardens 
•	Gas Fired Heating
